platform_notes: Same tokenizer / start_token / template / shape notes as the int8 file

Size option (39% smaller). On the Galaxy S26 it is NOT faster than int8: GPU decode 32-40 vs 36 tok/s (pair noisy), CPU decode 19 vs 20-21, and CPU prefill is 2.4x slower (133 vs 295-349) - the int4 dequant on the linears buys nothing while the int8 embedding + lm_head dominate

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (2026-09-02, 205-token prompt, 2 runs per cell): GPU 862-895 tok/s prefill / 36.2-36.5 decode against CPU 295-349 / 20.1-21.0; peak 849 MB (GPU) vs 1623 MB (CPU). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win. int8 is the card's recommended file (closest to bf16); the int4 sibling is not faster on this handset

measured on one Pixel 8a with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): gpu decodes 16.73 tok/s against cpu's 8.7 (1.9x), prefill 296.4 vs 70.3-73.3 tok/s, peak 2266 vs 1621 MB, engine init 28.9 vs 7.2 s. Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win for gpu on decode. Same ordering as on the Galaxy S26's Adreno (gpu 1.8x). The GPU engine init is 20-29 s against 7-8 s on the CPU, so a short session pays for it in the first reply, and it peaks at 2.2-2.3 GB against 1.6 GB. Both backends answered the probe (the GPU reply opened 'The capitular capital of France is Paris'); no exactness check beyond the probe was run

platform_notes: Tested on litert-lm 0.16.x (macOS CLI + python API, Android litert_lm_advanced_main v0.16.0 kit)

Embeds the HF tokenizer.json, not the vendor tokenizer.model: sarashina's SentencePiece model types every chat special (<|user|> <|assistant|> <|system|> </s>) as CONTROL, which a bare sentencepiece encoder never matches from text; engine-vs-HF ids identical on 7 probes
No start_token: add_bos_token is false and the official template emits no <s>; a prepended BOS measurably hurts this checkpoint in bf16 (8Q EN 6->5, JA 8->7)
Structured prompt templates (<|user|>...</s>, <|assistant|>...</s>, <|system|>...</s>), stop id 2; KV budget 4096, 11 prefill signatures (1-1024)
Recommended file: closest to bf16, and on the Galaxy S26 not slower than int4 on either backend (the untied 102,400 vocab makes the int8 embedding + lm_head the dominant per-token cost at this size)
